dedupe_keys.name: arms agricultural resource management survey farm financial and crop production practices data

description: The Agricultural Resource Management Survey is the U.S. Department of Agriculture's main source of information on the production practices, resource use and economic well-being of America's farms and ranches, published by the Economic Research Service. It is chosen here as the resilience-relevant product in the ERS data product catalogue. Coverage is national, with State-level data through the API. Access is free. The ARMS Data Dissemination Tool gives tailored reports on the structure, financial status and performance of farm operators, their households and farm businesses, with charting and an application program interface. Farm Structure and Finance data were last updated on 20 March 2026 and include 2024. A bulk file holds 2024 national estimates for each tailored report across farm types and operator characteristics; other years are available on request from the ARMS team. Crop Production Practices reports give status and trends for several field crops. No licence is stated on the page read; the data are a U.S. Government product. Caveats: the practices data were last updated in 2015 from the 2013 survey, the bulk file holds only one year, and survey estimates carry sampling error. For simulation it gives farm income, debt, assets and costs by farm type to model the financial exposure and recovery capacity of farms after droughts, floods or price shocks. Related catalogue records include USDA NASS Quick Stats, the USDA RMA cause-of-loss data and the EU Farm Sustainability Data Network.
